faqs.q: How does this tool prevent formatting loss compared to other converters?
faqs.a: Instead of creating fragmented text boxes for every word, our engine calculates spatial bounding boxes and line heights to group text into natural Word paragraphs with consistent margins.

faqs.q: Can I edit the converted Word file as normal reflowable text?
faqs.a: Yes. The generated .docx document uses standard paragraph and heading tags, allowing you to edit, add, or delete text without breaking adjacent paragraphs.

faqs.q: Are tables and multi-page documents supported?
faqs.a: Yes. Multi-page documents automatically include clean page breaks, and tabular lines are organized sequentially.

faqs.q: What fonts are used in the converted Word document?
faqs.a: The engine maps standard PDF font families (such as Helvetica, Times, Courier, and Arial) to universally supported OpenXML font definitions like Calibri, Arial, and Times New Roman.

faqs.q: Is there any cost, subscription, or watermark added?
